steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each payment needs an invoice, an approver within limit, no duplicate, and a second approval for changed bank details.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Payment above the approver's limit
findings.fix: Hold the payment until the right approver signs

findings.title: Supplier bank details changed with no second approval
findings.fix: Verify the change by phone before paying

findings.title: Payment with no invoice
findings.fix: Match the payment to an invoice

outcome.notChecked: Whether the goods or services were received.

pros: Checks a payment with no invoice, a payment above the approver's limit, a duplicate payment, and a supplier whose bank details changed with no second approval.
cons: Not checked: Whether the goods or services were received.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-payables-run skill on the records for this review.
